reviews.title: Excellent and quick assistance from…
reviews.body:
Excellent and quick assistance from Pratiksha K!
I accidentally purchased a plan on a new SIM instead of applying it to my existing line, resulting in a duplicate charge. Pratiksha K was incredibly helpful and quick to resolve the issue. She transferred the 30GB 12-month plan to my current number and processed a full refund for the extra payment without any hassle. Brilliant service!  
And here is a quick message to send back in the chat once you've submitted it:
Thanks Pratiksha, I've just posted the Trustpilot review with your name! Thanks again for all your help.

reviews.title: Purchased a sim card earlier this year…
reviews.body: Purchased a sim card earlier this year for £5 for a family trip to India. The signal and service was great with no issues. Returned and cancelled all details of the account and payments. Cheekily, Lebara have continued to take payments for several months, my mistake of not noticing these payments. I have contacted Lebara...awaiting a response. I will update Trustpilot, I hope its sooner than later.

reviews.title: Where can I see my new plan?
reviews.body:
I had a question about my plan as I'm new to Lebara. I'd already had my number ported over from another provider.
I didn't know why I couldn't see my plan on my account, so I opened a chat window. Harshal Bhosale was the agent today. He was friendly, patient and knowledgable. He knew straight away how to help, and guided me to the information I needed.
I am now a very happy customer.
Thank you!!

reviews.title: This network is a complete and utter…
reviews.body:
This network is a complete and utter disaster.  I have now been without mobile service for 5 days!  I have an elderley mother that cannot call me.  The port has failed!!  I have no access to any service that they charged me for.  

The advisor both over the telephone and on the online chat don't care or don't know.  This is outrageous.  Never ever again! they have no idea what they are doing.
